why_it_discriminates: The bugs are split across the entry script and a sourced library: word-splitting in the file loop, unquoted basename/gzip/redirect in the helper, a helper whose status is its trailing echo, and a tee pipeline that masks failures. A partial fix (quote the helper only, or add set -e only) still fails either the spaces or the exit-status checks, so the agent must trace the whole status path and verify with its own runs.
